summary: Spell-preview data for force (push/pull) effects of the spell being targeted, added by bg3.exe+0x1ED9230 (spell preview update) with ecl::spell_preview::EffectsComponent and filled from FUN_141f6c660 (likely ecl::spell_preview::GetForceFunctorParams, named on macOS). The first 0x18 bytes are an eoc::ForceFunctorParams (same members as Script Extender's ForceFunctor arguments in Stats/Functors.h); +0x18 maps target entities to path previewers. Born live in a targeting step together with EffectsComponent, HighlightsComponent, SurfaceTilesComponent and spell_cast::TargetingComponent.

Names of +0..+0x11 follow Script Extender's ForceFunctor arguments, matched by type and order; the game's ForceFunctorParams member names are not confirmed.
